questions.text: You submitted health-claim receipts totalling BDT 4,000 this month. How much will you actually get reimbursed?
Who qualifies for the standard referral bonus at Exabyting?
options: Any referred candidate who passes probation
Software engineers with over two years of post-graduation experience
Only candidates referred during an ongoing campaign
Any Exabytian referred by another employee

questions.text: Two employees both refer the same candidate. Who gets the referral bonus?
options: The one with the longer tenure at Exabyting
The one whose candidate accepts the offer
The one whose referral email arrived first
The bonus is split between both

questions.text: What happens if you refer a candidate who is already in Exabyting's recruitment process?
options: The referral still counts after their joining
The referral counts, but the bonus is halved
It is not considered a referral at all

questions.text: Under the IT Asset Incentive, which item is mandatory in your claim?
If you leave Exabyting, what happens to the accessories you bought through the IT Asset Incentive?
options: They must be returned to IT
They are bought back at 50% of the receipt value
They are personally yours — nothing to return
They must be handed over unless you replace them

questions.text: When can you re-claim an IT accessory under the incentive because your current one died?
options: Anytime, up to twice a year
Only during the annual renewal window
Only if it is out of warranty and non-functional, with the old item handed to IT

questions.text: What is the maximum outstanding loan balance an employee can carry at any time?
Your loan is approved with no other outstanding loan. By when must your first EMI installment start?
options: No later than three months from initiation

questions.text: A health-claim receipt is one and a half months old when you try to submit it. What happens?
options: It is rejected — claims older than one month cannot proceed
It is accepted via the late-submission process, but paid with next month's salary
It is auto-carried to next month's cycle at full value

questions.text: The office transport doesn't show up, so you commute on your own. How are you reimbursed?
options: BDT 10 per km, based on distance from your residence
BDT 10 per km, only above 10 km

questions.text: You normally take the office transport, but just for one day you want to use your own vehicle. Are you eligible for the transport allowance for that day?
options: Only if the transport was full

questions.text: How is one day's salary calculated for the Martian (holiday work) allowance?
Do extra working days boost your Supernova Bonus attendance?
options: Yes, each extra day counts double
Yes, if approved by the DL
No — extra days are already rewarded via the Martian Allowance
Only extra days at the bKash office

questions.text: How does the Aurora Borealis (night release) allowance work?
options: BDT 1,000 per release, capped at one release per day
BDT 1,000 per release, scaled by hours worked

questions.text: Can you claim both the Aurora Borealis and Martian allowances for the same day?
options: Yes, but each at half rate
No — they can't be claimed together for the same day
Only if the release ends after midnight

questions.text: When a seat opens up at Exanest and multiple employees have applied for regular stay, who gets it?
options: The employee with the longest tenure at Exabyting

questions.text: For office lunch, who is automatically counted for the daily meal?
options: Everyone in the Slack lunch channel
Anyone who booked the previous day
Anyone physically at the office by 11:00 AM

questions.text: The BatMobile transport allowance is post-paid. When is it disbursed?
options: Before the 20th of the following month
On demand via the reimbursement form

questions.text: The child allowance for an employee with three children is:
options: BDT 2,500, paid to the employee's own account
BDT 2,500 fixed, paid only to the spouse's bank account
BDT 5,000, paid to the spouse's account
